subject: collapsible panels in shinyBS conflicting with bootstrap.css

messages.author: d4b814fe2ccd924a
messages.subject: collapsible panels in shinyBS conflicting with bootstrap.css
parts:
Hi everyone,
I'm trying to implement collapsible panels using Eric Bailey's great "shinyBS" package.
http://spark.rstudio.com/johnharrison/shinyBS-Demo/

However, the panels don't work when I link to bootstrap.css (which I do for my theme); ie. in ui.R when I do this:
(shinyUI(fluidPage(theme="bootstrap.css",
 # bsCollapse example goes here.
   
)))

Commenting out theme="bootstrap.css" gets the panels to work, but then I lose all my CSS settings, something I would rather not do.

My guess is that bootstrap.css and shinyBS' css are clashing on some common class/variable definition. I'm learning CSS/JS as I go along; is there some simple way to keep the two namespaces apart without having to dig into exactly where the conflict arises?

Thanks,
Shraddha

messages.author: f029ef251685fb47
messages.subject: Re: collapsible panels in shinyBS conflicting with bootstrap.css
parts:
I found the solution! At least for my case! In the bootstrap.css file, the lines:

.modal-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 1040;
  background-color: #000000;
}

Changes to:

.modal-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  -z-index: 1040;
  background-color: #000000;
}

The problem is in the z-index. Disable this line works like a charm!

Att,
